edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth, and asking whether the change takes a campaign (an umbrella's review is a spec campaign or the operator's approval, umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling it is made on its own branch, runs that campaign where the ruling calls for one, and lands as soon as its diff is operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the decision ask now also asks whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign where the ruling calls for one.
